definition: A Notable Lot advertisement is ONE REAL ITEM inside ONE REAL AUCTION/EVENT used as a discovery hook for THE LARGER CATALOG. It is not a general auction advertisement with luxurious imagery.
structure_to_learn: 'Notable Lot' label (or the event's own featured-lot label)
CTA to the real catalog or lot page
the item visually dominant (≥ 45% of the field), the event clearly identified, light ground

fact_sources.attribution/artist/material/age/provenan: lot record fields ONLY, verbatim; if absent → omitted
fact_sources.auction_size: live catalogue count at generation, re-verified at publish (A2 manifest)
fact_sources.value/estimate: never shown unless a production estimate field exists and the Owner has enabled estimates in creative
fact_sources.image: the lot's own CLEAN photograph(s) — tier 5 object composition with ONE object, or the lot photo as an environmental/hero image; never a representative object

training_example.rule: structure may be learned; these strings are FICTIONAL_TRAINING_FACT_NEVER_PRODUCTION; the claim manifest rejects any of them; the principle extractor strips all facts from notable-lot lessons

ground: light/white default (Owner preferred the light recreation over the dark one); dark only under color-system.json dark_treatments
cta: 'View Catalog' / 'View Lot' with the real destination from the event/lot record
qa: every fact traces to a lot/event field (G13 provenance extended to facts)
hero object is the lot's own image
no representative merchandise in the frame beyond the lot's own photograph context
event identified (type + date) at EVENT-profile prominence
